limitations: Breed not stated anywhere reachable (strain or breed = not available).

Sv39–Sv42 are flagged IsTechrep=TRUE in the design but the sample they replicate is not named; they are annotated as their own sources.
MS-GF+ was also used; its tolerances were not read (only the X!Tandem block).
Paper full text not open access; no per-bull fertility group other than the deposited design table was used.
The design lists 21 bulls; the abstract says 20 — not reconciled.
